title: Bunny Companion reviewer observation
description: One structured remark from an observation-only reviewer. Reviewers may inspect a redacted view of a task and say what is wrong with it; they may not execute tools, modify files, approve actions, control applications, change configuration, send task data anywhere, or override the executor. This document is the whole of what a reviewer can put into the record. The reviewerId is checked against the identity the runtime invoked, so a reviewer cannot attribute a remark — or a disagreement — to another.

severity.description: "blocking" does not stop the task — reviewers cannot stop anything — but high and above are recorded as a disagreement rather than an observation, and a disagreement stays in the stream even after the executor revises around it.

evidenceEventIds.description: Events in the same session that support the remark, so a reader can check it rather than take it.

examples.summary: The proposed output omits the requested validation step.
